This is a senior testing leadership opportunity within a fast-growing, international digital environment spanning insurance, e-commerce, and device protection. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on QA leadership, giving you significant influence over quality standards and delivery outcomes. As a testing SME, you will define methodologies, mentor teams, manage risks, and ensure robust quality gates. Lead and coordinate testing activities across multiple concurrent projects, delivery streams, internal teams, and external partners. Own the end-to-end testing lifecycle, from test planning and scenario development through execution, defect management, reporting, and test closure. Define and maintain testing strategies, plans, goals, closure reports, and other key testing artefacts. Support resource management and step into hands-on QA responsibilities when required. Monitor testing progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and, where applicable, costs, providing clear status reporting to stakeholders. Demonstrated experience across the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), including SIT, UAT, and ORT. Previous hands-on experience as a QA Lead, Test Lead, or QA Engineer, with the ability to contribute technically when required. Strong experience coordinating multi-stream teams, external partners, and third-party vendors. Extensive practical knowledge of JIRA and Confluence for project tracking, documentation, and test management. Experience with test automation and at least one recognised industry-standard automation framework. Strong capabilities in test planning, test case and scenario development, defect management, test data management, and quality reporting. Comfortable working across both Agile methodologies, including Scrum or Kanban, and Waterfall delivery models. Experience working with sensitive customer data and an understanding of relevant testing and data-handling considerations. Good knowledge of testing methodology, insurance/device protection, or e-commerce; experience in insurtech, fintech, or regulated digital platforms is an advantage. Ability to understand, interpret, and validate business and application requirements within complex digital environments. Strong communication, stakeholder management, leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Full professional fluency in English and Spanish , both written and spoken. Experience with AI, API, or RPA technologies, introducing testing tools, or working within a testing Centre of Excellence is a plus. Benefits: Remote working opportunity within Europe. You will work closely with the Operations Manager to translate broader objectives into effective day-to-day execution. Your focus will include workforce planning, attendance, quality assurance, coaching, onboarding, and operational administration. You will help grow the operation toward a target of 100 active agents while maintaining consistent performance and reliability. Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate rosters, schedules, documentation, and operational records. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, operational tracking systems, and basic financial or invoicing information. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate records. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with agents, managers, and clients. Proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with operational leadership.
